comparison.objective: Apply an amblyopia patch to the stronger eye indicated indirectly by a chart; no spec versions are available.
comparison.physical_skill: Semantic target selection and compliant patch placement.
comparison.success_condition: Patch center is within 1.5 cm of the correct eye for full credit; wrong/both eyes, moved head/chart, or held patch score zero.
comparison.reason: Target selection and surface patching are unrelated to bimanual impact tooling and notch-fragment containment.
